Bul till now we are not cured. Becoz the man who do the sehar on us he repeat it. So plese tell us some amal that can cure us completely. Answer ID: 14749 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1329/1084=D/1430) You should not fall in suspicions just by saying of so many people. If it is diagnosed by any expert and religious aamil , you should ask him to cure. However, you should do the amal mentioned in Akhtari Bahishti Zewar vol 9, page 90. Also, recite Manzil book daily at home. In-sha-Allah all such effects will vanish if there are any. Manzil is complied by Hadhrat Shaikhul Hadith Zakariya, it may be available at shops where Islamic books are sold. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
